beta_description: During the beta the Redline team verifies owners by hand, after a check outside the app. Until then your car is waiting for verification and gets no pings, no stats and no showcase. Automatic verification with a one-time code is coming soon.
verified_description: Auto-fill now recognises your car when someone spots it, and you get a ping every time it is collected.
title: Verification
step_add_body: Your plate is stored as a code, never as text.
step_check_title: The Redline team checks your ownership
step_check_body: During the beta this happens by hand, after a check outside the app.
step_pings_body: Each time your car is spotted, you see the city, the hour and the blurred photo.
code_step_write: Write the code on paper or show it on another screen.
code_step_photo: Photograph the car so the plate and the code are both readable.
expired: This code has expired. Request a new one.
